title: Add paginated order listing
body: Adds GET /orders?page=N, 20 orders per page, newest first. The admin dashboard will call it.

labels.note: Pages are numbered from 1 and the handler defaults to page=1, but the offset is page * PageSize. Page 1 skips the 20 newest orders, which no page ever returns. The offset should be (page - 1) * PageSize.
